options.name: computer
options.description: The host or alias to configure the SPN for. Can include the port in the format C(host:port).

options.name: computer_password
options.description: Password of a credential to connect to Active Directory with.

options.name: computer_username
options.description: Username of a credential to connect to Active Directory with.

options.name: service_account
options.description: The account you want the SPN added to. Will be looked up if not provided.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the object should be C(present) or C(absent).
